title: Playboy Magazine January 1974 20th Anniversary Issue Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Vintage 1974 issue. Light scuffing and small white marks on the black front cover, wear along the spine edge, and toning with light smudges on the back cover margins. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 1974 - the 20th Anniversary Issue (Vol. 21 No. 1), original $1.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Classic all-black cover with the white Rabbit Head logo.

Back cover: Kool cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
